subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this PR land as the focused doctor auth migration fix now, or should maintainers require broader shipped-shape coverage or bundle it with adjacent auth migration work first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well evidenced, but it changes upgrade-time handling of OAuth and SecretRef material, which needs owner confirmation rather than automated repair.

options.title: Land after auth owner/security pass
options.body: Accept the focused fix with its current before/after proof and tests once the auth/security owner signs off on the migration contract.

options.title: Add shipped-shape coverage first
options.body: Require one more regression based on an observed shipped auth-profile shape before merge.

options.title: Hold for adjacent migration coordination
options.body: Pause only if maintainers decide this field-preservation fix must land together with the separate auth migration work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93352.

recommendation.title: Land after auth owner/security pass
recommendation.body: Accept the focused fix with its current before/after proof and tests once the auth/security owner signs off on the migration contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-profile refactor that created this migration surface was authored by steipete, and CODEOWNERS routes auth-sensitive agent code to security ownership.
